node.title: Re: Can't get \n or other character/translation escapes to interpolate if originally read from a data file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Note that the other suggested solutions of [mod://String::Interpolate] and [doc://eval] introduce security risks. For something less risky, see [mod://String::Unescape], which only works with a subset of Perl's escape sequences, and AFAICT from a quick look at the source none of them appear to be security-relevant.
